name: User Interface Security Issues
description: Weaknesses in this category are related to or introduced in the User Interface (UI).

notes.text: User interface errors that are relevant to security have not been studied at a high level.

mapping_notes.rationale: This entry is a Grouping. Using groupings for mapping has been discouraged since 2019. They are informal organizational groupings of weaknesses that can help CWE users with data aggregation, navigation, and browsing. However, they are not weaknesses in themselves.
mapping_notes.comments: See member weaknesses of this category.
